page.overview:
What is Blade of Zakata Par?

The Blade of Zakata Par was an artifact Phee Genoa claimed to have found. On a journey to the Kaldar Trinary system between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, Genoa offered to tell the young clone Omega the story of how she had found the blade, which Omega was interested in. As she began, Genoa described the tale as "exciting" and advised Omega to strap in.
